description: Validate a phone number: is it a well-formed E.164 number, and what country calling code and region does it carry? Pure format + country check, no network call, no message sent. Free. For the authoritative carrier and line type (mobile / landline / VoIP), use the paid phone-intel tool.

number.description: Phone number in E.164 (+14155552671) or loosely formatted

name: validate_phone
